class.name: TickMultiplayerPeer
class.description: Lets [SceneMultiplayer] (RPCs, [MultiplayerSpawner], [MultiplayerSynchronizer]) use the players' mesh, next to the [TickNetwork] on the same transport. Every player is reached, directly or relayed by the host, which is peer 1 (the server for [SceneMultiplayer]). Get it with [method EnetHostedMeshTransport.get_multiplayer_peer]. It has [constant EnetHostedMeshTransport.MULTIPLAYER_CHANNEL_COUNT] transfer channels and doesn't need the server relay of [SceneMultiplayer]: the transport relays.
